targets.name: Nelson Chang
targets.background: Grandson of Zhang Shiming (one of China's wealthiest during Republican era). Father Zhang Shuxun was 'King of Coins' with one of the greatest ancient Chinese cash collections ever assembled. NC Collection sold for $18M at Champion Auctions in 2021.
targets.angle: Fellow serious collector; his family legacy aligns with your mission of preservation and documentation
targets.notes: Contact via Champion Auctions (Michael Chou) who handled NC Collection sale. Wall Street trader background - might appreciate tech/fintech angle.

targets.name: Peter Fung
targets.background: Hong Kong financier, founder of Liang Yi Museum on Hollywood Road. Collection of 6,800+ artifacts. Museum named after his two daughters.
targets.angle: Already operates a private museum; potential advisor or exhibition partner. Could share insights on transitioning from private collection to public display.
targets.notes: Museum at 181-199 Hollywood Road, Sheung Wan. Open by appointment Mon-Fri 10am-6pm. Lynn Fung (daughter) also involved - see CFA interview.

targets.name: Alan Chuang Shaw Swee
targets.background: Hong Kong tycoon with one of the most important imperial Chinese porcelain collections formed in recent decades (14th-18th century).
targets.angle: Understands long-term collection building; could advise on acquisitions strategy
targets.notes: Approach via Sotheby's HK who featured his collection

targets.name: Betty Lo & Kenneth Chu
targets.background: Third-generation collectors. Donated nearly 1,400 gold and silver objects spanning 3,000 years to Hong Kong Palace Museum - the largest donation to date. Mengdiexuan Collection ('Butterfly Dream Studio').
targets.angle: Direct overlap with your jewelry/rings focus. Major philanthropists who understand the value of preservation. Betty is on CUHK Advisory Board.
targets.notes: HIGHEST PRIORITY - collection focus overlaps significantly. Contact via HKPM development team (development@hkpm.org.hk) or through their talks/symposiums at HKPM.

targets.name: Anthony Cheung
targets.background: Huaihaitang Collection. Donated imperial porcelain of Ming and Qing dynasties to Hong Kong Palace Museum.
targets.angle: Active donor interested in preservation; understands institutional partnerships

targets.name: Lawrence Chan
targets.background: Dawentang Collection. Donated Ming and Qing porcelain to Hong Kong Palace Museum.
targets.angle: Philanthropic collector who values institutional preservation

targets.name: Brian McElney
targets.background: Donated 63 Chinese antiquities to Hong Kong Museum of Art (Qing ceramics, bamboo objects).
targets.angle: Active museum donor in HK; understands the donation process

targets.name: Ma Tak Wo
targets.background: President of Hong Kong Numismatic Society since 1986. Advisor to Chinese Numismatic Society (2008). Founded HICC in 1982. Ma Tak Wo Numismatic Co. (since 1999).
targets.angle: Gatekeeper to serious HK coin collectors. Could introduce you to the right people and validate your collection.
targets.notes: PRIORITY. Contact via HICC (info@hicc.hk) or LinkedIn. Also WhatsApp/LINE (HICC852).

targets.name: Wong Hon Sum
targets.background: Honorary President and Founder of Numismatic Society (Asia), Singapore (1998). Regional network of collectors across Asia.
targets.angle: Regional network across Asia; could connect you to collectors beyond HK
targets.notes: Singapore-based. Contact via nsa.sg website or Instagram @numismaticsociety_asia. Address: 60 Paya Lebar Road #07-54 Paya Lebar Square Singapore 409051

targets.name: Stack's Bowers and Ponterio (Hong Kong)
targets.background: Led Asian coin market development since 2010. $100M+ in Asian coin sales over 7 years. Organizes Hong Kong Coin Show.
targets.angle: They know every serious collector in the region. Potential consignment partner for sales. Could provide introductions.
targets.notes: Good for both sales and networking. Has local coin shop in HK for appraisals.

targets.name: Heritage Auctions (Hong Kong)
targets.background: World's largest numismatic auction house. Opened HK office in 2015. Co-organizes HKINF. Office at Unit 802, 8/F Tower Two, Lippo Centre, 89 Queensway Road, Admiralty.
targets.angle: Industry relationships, potential sales channel, event networking (HKINF)
targets.notes: HKINF December 2025 is a key networking opportunity. CrisB@HA.com is Cristiano Bierrenbach, EVP International Numismatics.

targets.name: HICC (Hong Kong International Coin & Watch Convention)
targets.chineseName: 香港國際錢幣鐘錶展銷會
targets.background: Founded 1982 by Ma Tak Wo. Annual coin and watch show at Holiday Inn Golden Mile. Key networking event.
targets.angle: Attend April 2026 show for networking. Could potentially exhibit or sponsor.
targets.notes: Next show April 2026. Also has LINE (HICC852) and WeChat. Address: B-113A, 50 Nathan Road, TST.

targets.name: Hong Kong Arts Development Council
targets.background: Statutory body for arts development (est. 1995). Offers Project Grants and Cultural Exchange Grants.
targets.angle: Could fund documentation, exhibition, or educational projects. Project Grant deadlines: 30 June and 31 December.
targets.notes: Formal grant application process. Submit by email with supporting docs via share link.

targets.name: Arts Capacity Development Funding Scheme
targets.background: Government scheme (Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau) for large-scale, cross-year arts initiatives.
targets.angle: For bigger projects like exhibition space or major acquisitions
targets.notes: Requires established organization; may need to partner. Lower priority for now.

targets.name: Asia Society Hong Kong
targets.background: Arts and Culture Promotional Fund. Located at Former Explosives Magazine, 9 Justice Drive, Admiralty.
targets.angle: Event sponsorship, exhibition partnership. Also has Community Fund and arts programs.
targets.notes: General: enquiryhk@asiasociety.org. Programs: programHK@asiasociety.org. Open Tue-Sun 11am-6pm.

targets.name: Hong Kong Palace Museum
targets.background: Chinese art and cultural heritage. Actively accepting private donations. Founding Patrons program.
targets.angle: Long-term loan or exhibition partnership. Could validate collection quality. Also route to reach private donors (Betty Lo, Anthony Cheung, etc).
targets.notes: For donations: donation@hkpm.org.hk. For membership: member@hkpm.org.hk. Object donations accepted with images + provenance.

targets.name: Hong Kong Museum of Art
targets.background: Collections include Chinese antiquities, calligraphy, painting. Over 19,700 items. Est. 1962. Major donors include Chih Lo Lou Collection, Edward T. Chow, Brian McElney.

targets.name: M+ Museum
targets.background: Modern focus but active patronage network. Founding Patrons program (160+ members as of 2021).
targets.angle: Less relevant to antiquities but strong patronage network; could provide connections
targets.notes: Modern focus - lower priority but worth networking
